item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:
Russian drone strikes killed 13 people at a Ukrainian railway station and prompted further attacks on transport hubs, while Russian strikes cut power to thousands as the Kherson ceasefire ends. In the occupied city of Oleshky a localized cease-fire entered its third day, allowing evacuees to cross into Ukraine via Belarus, but attacks on aid vehicles continue. Russia is adapting drones with makeshift armor made from nets and rubber tires, and Ukrainian clergy have suffered heavy losses with 120 members reported killed. The conflict still accounts for 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.description:
